description: This file defines the MySugar class, which manages dashboard interactions, including adding, displaying, deleting, and searching for dashlets in the SuiteCRM platform. It contains methods for mananging user preferences, security checks, and rendering dashlet content.

classes.name: MySugar
classes.description: A class managing dashboard dashlets, including adding, display, deletion, searching, and configuration, within the SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for initializing MySugar class with a specific dashboard type.

methods.name: checkDashletDisplay
methods.description: Checks whether a dashlet of a given type should be displayed based on user permissions and module support.

methods.name: addDashlet
methods.description: Handles the addition of a new dashlet to the user's dashboard, including cache rebuilding and permission validation.

methods.name: displayDashlet
methods.description: Displays a specific dashlet's content, processing sorting and rendering logic.

methods.name: getPredefinedChartScript
methods.description: Retrieves a predefined chart script associated with a dashlet.

methods.name: deleteDashlet
methods.description: Deletes a dashlet from the user's dashboard based on provided ID.

methods.name: dashletsDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog allowing users to select and add new dashlets.

methods.name: searchModuleToolsDashlets
methods.description: Searches through module or tools dashlets matching the search string.

methods.name: searchChartsDashlets
methods.description: Searches through chart dashlets matching the search string.

methods.name: searchDashlets
methods.description: Routes the search request to the appropriate search method.

methods.name: configureDashlet
methods.description: Provides the configuration interface or saves settings for a dashlet.

methods.name: saveLayout
methods.description: Saves the user's custom dashboard layout configuration.
